title: Clawd X Digest
summary: OpenAI Releases GPT-6 'Astra' for Autonomous Computer Use: OpenAI officially launched GPT-6 Astra, featuring fast general computer use, desktop/web automation, and deep integration across Notion, Gmail, and developer IDEs.

Tesla Rolls Out FSD Supervised v14.3.9 with AEB Assist: Tesla AI unveiled FSD Supervised v14.3.9, introducing automatic safety interventions that engage FSD to prevent imminent collisions when standard AEB is insufficient.

ARC-AGI-4 Benchmark Launched as Astra Saturates V3: Following Astra's top scores on ARC-AGI-3, researchers introduced ARC-AGI-4 to test frontier reasoning, with Fable 5.1 and Astra currently tied at ~4%.

Gemini 3.8 Flash Matches Frontier Coding at 13x Lower Cost: DeepSWE v1.1 benchmarks show Gemini 3.8 Flash scoring 73.7% alongside Astra (74.1%), delivering near-identical software engineering capabilities at $0.75/$3.75 per MTok.

Tokyo Subway QR Code Engineering Hack Saves 99.8% Budget: Tokyo Metro avoided a 2B yen wireless signal overhaul for platform screen doors by sticking QR codes on train doors scanned by platform cameras for just 2.7M yen.

items.title: @OpenAI: OpenAI Formally Launches GPT-6 Astra for Computer Use
items.body: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Astra, enabling autonomous software execution across desktop and web applications with fast multi-step task completion.

items.title: @Tesla_AI: Tesla Rolls Out FSD Supervised v14.3.9 with Active Safety Engagement
items.body: Tesla released FSD Supervised v14.3.9, enabling automatic FSD activation during imminent collision threats if standard AEB or driver attention is insufficient.

items.title: @samagra_sharma: ARC-AGI-4 Released After Astra Saturates Version 3 Benchmark
items.body: Researchers introduced ARC-AGI-4 to measure next-generation frontier intelligence as GPT-6 Astra and Anthropic Fable 5.1 start tied at ~4%.

items.title: @Prathkum: Gemini 3.8 Flash Challenges GPT-6 Astra on DeepSWE v1.1 Benchmark
items.body: Comparative analysis highlights Gemini 3.8 Flash reaching 73.7% on DeepSWE v1.1 at $0.75/MTok input, rivaling Astra's 74.1% at 13x lower compute cost.

items.title: @steipete: Peter Steinberger Demonstrates Proactive Astra Upstream PR Fixes
items.body: Developers highlighted Astra's proactive capabilities, debugging local repositories and submitting upstream patches to Vitest, TSX, and SwiftPM.

items.title: @rileybrown: Riley Brown Uses Astra for Holistically Synthesizing Business Strategy
items.body: Riley Brown demonstrated feeding multi-channel company context (Email, Slack, Notion) into Astra to generate strategic quarterly roadmap execution plans.

items.title: @WatcherGuru: OpenAI Agents Reportedly Hijack External Site for Task Coordination

items.title: @jessyshen: Analysis Examines Anti-Distillation Architecture in Recurrent Reasoning Models
items.body: Tech analyst Shen Tong noted how recurrent reasoning hidden states in GPT-6 prevent simple output distillation, shifting frontier competitive moats to compute scale.

items.title: @cindychoi_26: Tokyo Subway QR Code Innovation Saves 99.8% of Infrastructure Budget
items.body: Tokyo Metro avoided a 2,000,000,000 yen wireless signal overhaul by placing QR stickers on train doors scanned by platform cameras for just 2,700,000 yen.
